resources.string: Documents, camera OCR, reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, and listening history stay on this device. Speech is generated on the device, and no text is sent anywhere.

Third-party components in this app: Google ML Kit text recognition (runs on the device to read scanned pages, sends no data), sherpa-onnx (runs on the device to speak text, sends no data) and HUAWEI In-App Purchases (used only when you buy or restore Vox Pro; the purchase goes through HMS Core to Huawei). Tap Agree to continue.
